text:
rachel-partners: Heads-up: DeepVault (hardware partner) wants to publish their edge gateway in the cloud marketplace. Marketplace compliance asks for signed firmware + notarization, SBOM, SOC2 pointer, redacted pen-test, and chain-of-custody. Can we align on a minimal deliverable and upload flow?

omar-security: Minimum bundle: SOC2 summary URL, redacted pentest PDF (no customer PII), CycloneDX SBOM, detached firmware signatures with RFC3161 timestamp tokens, signer cert chain (PEM), chain-of-custody PDF signed by vendor, and HSM/KMS signer metadata.

tess-eng: Packaging preference: one attest tarball per release: deepvault/<version>/attest-v1.tar.gz. Root must include manifest.json (file->sha256 map), README.md (redaction notes + contact), and a short human-readable signer statement.txt.

sam-deepvault: DeepVault here we can produce detached .sig files and request RFC3161 timestamps from TimeStampHub. HSM attestation logs are large; can we provide a hashed reference + signed retrieval URL?

omar-security: Hashed reference OK if the retrieval URL is signed and the manifest contains the hash and retrieval instructions. For audits we may request full logs later. Also require KMS or HSM identifier included in manifest.

li-ps: Upload flow proposal: 1) partner requests presigned multipart upload to s3://redwood-partner-ingest/deepvault/<version>/attest-v1.tar.gz 2) we provide per-part presigns (default TTL 24h) 3) partner completes upload and posts manifest sha256 + final ETag 4) security does redaction verification and final sign-off. Target turnaround: 7 business days.

ops-bot: Policy reminder: partner-ingest bucket presign max TTL = 86400s. For >86400s or >10GB uploads tag `presign-extend` and request ops approval. Audit logging will capture uploader identity.

sam-deepvault: Estimated upload size ~2.8GB, 24h fine. Can you share manifest template and an example multipart presign flow?

tess-eng: Manifest template uploaded: https://drive.redwood/deepvault-manifest.json with fields vendor, version, release_timestamp, files_map (name->sha256), signer_cert_chain_pem, signature_files, sbom_filename, soc2_summary_url, pentest_redacted_filename, chain_of_custody_filename, hsm_attestation_ref_or_signed_url, signer_kms_id, contact_email, redaction_approver. Multipart presign snippet: `aws s3api create-multipart-upload --bucket redwood-partner-ingest --key deepvault/1.0.0/attest-v1.tar.gz` -> returns UploadId; we then generate presigned PUT URLs per part.

omar-security: Redaction rules: remove customer names, internal IPs, internal hostnames, and PII. Keep CVE IDs, CVSS scores, and remediation status. Redaction approver must initial `redaction_approved_by` in manifest before final handoff.

sam-deepvault: Thanks. We'll assemble and request presigns by 1749920000.

li-ps: Action items: - Sam/DeepVault: produce attest tarball + manifest (owner: sam-deepvault) - Tess: share presign/multipart instructions + presign-escalation path (owner: tess-eng) - Omar: publish redaction checklist + reserve review slot (owner: omar-security) - Li: publish manifest template + S3 prefix doc (owner: li-ps)

ops-bot: ingest prefix: s3://redwood-partner-ingest/deepvault/  presign-policy: max 86400s  audit: enabled.

rachel-partners: Great progress. I'll coordinate marketplace listing owner after artifacts are signed off. :thumbsup:
